title: Sailing by Starlight
body:
I drew this in Procreate as a submission for an issue cover contest July 2026. The theme was “North Star.” A timelapse of my progress is linked below. Procreate tracked 7 hours and 20 minutes spent on this piece.

[Sailing by Starlight Timelapse](https://youtu.be/TWs5hKuXEy0?is=dX1McSQJHBtW0zqm)
